evidence: GeTe ﬁlms were grown on 5 × 5 cm2 as-received Si and glass substrates in a ﬂow type F120 ALD reactor (ASM Microchemistry Oy, Helsinki, Finland) operated at a pressure of about 10 mbar with N2 (made on-site with Nitrox UHPN 3000 generator, rated purity 99.9995%) as the carrier and purge gas. GeCl2 · (C4H8O2) and (Et3Si)2Te were evaporated from open glass vessels inside the reactor at 65 and 40◦C, respectively, and pulsed with inert gas valving.
